candidate_workaround: Inspect exact local lines after lifecycle changes, then apply small independent patches instead of one broad context-dependent correction.

recurrence_guard: After a sealed lifecycle transition, inspect current constants, prose, and record lines before every correction patch.

title: Use exact small patches after terminal-correction context drift
trigger_preconditions: A correction patch contains prose or record context that may have changed since generation.
